claim: In the single-excitation \(XY\) model of Casaccino, Lloyd, Mancini, and Severini on the complete graph \(K_n\) with the input-output edge removed, let \(n\ge4\), keep every edge hopping equal to \(2\), and perturb the source's optimal equal endpoint shift \(2n-6\) antisymmetrically: \[\Delta_i=2n-6+\frac{\delta}{2},\qquad \Delta_j=2n-6-\frac{\delta}{2},\qquad \delta\in\mathbb R.\]Then the exact maximum transfer fidelity over all times is \[\boxed{F_{\max}(n,\delta)=\left(\frac{32(n-2)}{32(n-2)+\delta^2}\right)^2,}\]attained exactly when \[\boxed{t_k=\frac{2(2k+1)\pi}{\sqrt{32(n-2)+\delta^2}},\qquad k=0,1,2,\ldots.}\]Hence perfect state transfer survives if and only if \(\delta=0\). For a target fidelity \(\eta\in(0,1]\), the condition \(F_{\max}\ge\eta\) is exactly \[|\delta|\le \sqrt{32(n-2)\left(\eta^{-1/2}-1\right)}.\]In particular, for fixed \(\delta\), \[1-F_{\max}(n,\delta)=\frac{\delta^2}{16(n-2)}+O(n^{-2}),\]while for \(\delta=c\sqrt n\) one has the nontrivial scaling limit \[\lim_{n\to\infty}F_{\max}(n,c\sqrt n)=\left(\frac{32}{32+c^2}\right)^2.\]Thus the missing-link all-to-all transfer scheme has a sharp \(\sqrt n\) absolute tolerance to differential endpoint calibration error, even though any nonzero mismatch forbids exact perfect transfer.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; deterministic replay is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Exact global maximum fidelity and sharp calibration window for antisymmetric endpoint detuning around the published missing-link complete-graph control point.
integrity.ownership_basis: The mathematical bibliographic record for the source lists primary MSC 81P45.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The equal endpoint optimum, perfect-transfer time, and random-disorder study are credited to Casaccino, Lloyd, Mancini, and Severini.

scientific_limitations: The mean endpoint shift is fixed at the source optimum \(2n-6\).
Only differential endpoint-energy error is varied; coupling disorder and common-mode shift error are excluded.
The hopping normalization is the source convention, with value \(2\) on each present edge.
An equivalent formula may exist in broader weighted-graph literature under a different normalization.
title: Sharp tolerance to antisymmetric endpoint detuning in missing-link complete-graph state transfer
